stories.title: Oasis komt in juli naar Amsterdam met twee shows tijdens nieuwe tournee

en.title: Oasis to perform in Amsterdam in July with two shows during new tour
en.summary: Oasis announced two concerts in Amsterdam on July 16 and 17, 2027, as part of their reunion tour's second leg. The British band will also perform in Paris, Munich, and Rome during the tour.

stories.title: Band Oasis kondigt nieuwe tour aan, ook optredens in Amsterdam

en.title: Band Oasis announces new tour, also performing in Amsterdam
en.summary: Oasis announced a major international reunion tour with 38 concerts between May and September 2027, including two shows in Amsterdam on July 16 and 17. The band will perform in stadiums across Manchester, Munich, Paris, Boston, and other cities.

stories.title: Drie mogelijke Bolle Jos-handlangers opgepakt in Ghana

en.title: Three possible Bolle Jos associates arrested in Ghana
en.summary: Ghana's anti-drug agency arrested three suspected associates of drug criminal Jos L., known as Bolle Jos. The arrests follow a seizure of nearly 4,000 kilograms of cocaine by French customs at the port of Dunkirk, which originated from Ghana.

stories.title: Reclame met naakte Sydney Sweeney leidt tot ophef in sportwereld: ‘Klap in het gezicht van elke vrouw’

en.title: Advertisement featuring nude Sydney Sweeney sparks controversy in sports world: 'Slap in the face of every woman'
en.summary: An advertisement featuring actress Sydney Sweeney generated backlash within the sports community over its content and messaging.

stories.title: Drie handlangers van Bolle Jos opgepakt in Ghana

en.title: Three accomplices of Bolle Jos arrested in Ghana
en.summary: Three individuals have been arrested in Ghana on suspicion of representing a criminal and facilitating his illegal operations in the country.

stories.title: Ghana arresteert handlangers 'Bolle Jos' na vondst van bijna 4.000 kilo cocaïne

en.title: Ghana arrests accomplices of 'Bolle Jos' following discovery of nearly 4,000 kilos of cocaine
en.summary: Ghana arrested three suspected associates of a criminal figure following a seizure of 3,900 kilograms of cocaine in France.

stories.title: ‘Drie doden na crash met Hilversums vliegtuigje net over de Duitse grens’

en.title: 'Three dead after crash involving Hilversum aircraft just over German border'
en.summary: A Cessna 172 aircraft registered to a Hilversum flight school crashed near the German border, killing three people and becoming completely destroyed on impact.

stories.title: Vliegtuigje dat vertrok uit Hilversum neergestort in Duitsland, drie doden

en.title: Small aircraft departing from Hilversum crashes in Germany, three dead
en.summary: A small aircraft registered to Hilversum Flight School crashed in a field near Erkelenz on the German border, resulting in three fatalities. The aircraft took off at 10:25 from a small airfield.

stories.title: Drie doden doordat uit Hilversum vertrokken vliegtuigje neerstort in Duitsland

en.title: Three dead after small aircraft departing from Hilversum crashes in Germany
en.summary: A small aircraft that took off from Hilversum on Monday morning crashed just over the German border near Gerderath, resulting in three fatalities.

stories.title: Trein botst op vrachtwagen in Ermelo, chauffeur lichtgewond

en.title: Train collides with truck in Ermelo, driver slightly injured
en.summary: A train collided with a truck at a railway crossing in Ermelo, leaving the truck driver with minor injuries.

stories.title: Trein met 150 passagiers botst op vrachtwagen bij overweg in Ermelo

en.title: Train with 150 passengers collides with truck at level crossing in Ermelo
en.summary: A train carrying 150 passengers collided with a truck at a level crossing in Ermelo on Monday morning, injuring the truck driver who was taken to hospital. All passengers were evacuated.

stories.title: Trein botst op vrachtwagen bij Ermelo, treinverkeer ligt hele dag stil

en.title: Train collides with truck near Ermelo, train traffic halted all day
en.summary: A train carrying approximately 150 passengers collided with a truck at a railway crossing in Ermelo on Monday morning, causing injuries to the truck driver and two train passengers. The truck was transporting large concrete slabs.
